name: Decentral Life, Inc.
summary: Decentral Life, Inc. operates as a technology business incubator. The company offers digital asset accumulation; technology services; software-as-a-service (SaaS); AI data-as-a-service; blockchain-as-a-service; energy-as-a-service; tokenized AI compute infrastructure; microgrid energy solutions for AI and blockchain; and real-world asset tokens. The company was formerly known as Social Life Network, Inc. and changed its name to Decentral Life, Inc. in February 2022. Decentral Life, Inc. is based in Greenwood Village, Colorado.
